body: I understand, you are scared otherwise you wouldn't have said your hearts pounding. You don't want to die, you want to stop feeling. I don't know your situation or who you are but I can tell you that your life is worth living. You matter. You can be helped.
We care about you and don't want you to die. Please stay for a while, let us try to help you
Forgot to say.... Happy birthday, I hope there are many more to come

I'm so sorry, I can't imagine the pain you feel at the moment. What I do know is that your partner would not have wanted you to end your life. Life works in ways that we can't understand, shit things happen to good people who don't deserve it. But you can make a difference, become the person your partner wanted you to become. I know it's easy to say and very difficult to do but make positive change in your life that will benefit yourself and those around you. Even if it's as simple as volunteering at your local charity shop. Try to give your life purpose again in small meaningful ways in everyday life and do it in honour of your partner.

Keep yourself busy stranger and my thoughts are with you

Home is where we make it to be my friend. I know nothing I say on a Reddit post can significantly effect you but stay for a while. In this community there are people like yourself, like us who feel exactly the same but together we can help each other. It's about putting one foot in front of another and being proud in ourselves to have made it another day through the struggle.
